old_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a black gas stove top, featuring four burners. A person is seen using a steam cleaner to clean the stovetop. The steam cleaner emits a noticeable amount of steam as it moves across the surface. The camera moves slightly. The steam cleaner's nozzle is moved back and forth over each burner. The video concludes with the steam cleaner still in use, and the stovetop visibly wet and showing cleaning residue.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a black gas stove top, featuring four burners. A person wearing blue gloves is seen using a steam cleaner to clean the stovetop. The steam cleaner emits a noticeable amount of steam as it moves across the surface, effectively loosening dirt and grime. The camera remains steady, focusing on the cleaning process, capturing the transformation of the stovetop from dirty to clean. The steam cleaner's nozzle is moved back and forth over each burner, ensuring thorough cleaning. As the cleaning progresses, the steam becomes more intense, indicating the effectiveness of the steam cleaner in removing stubborn stains. The video concludes with the stovetop looking significantly cleaner than before, with the steam continuing to rise from the surface.
caption: A close, slightly high-angle view shows a black gas stovetop with four cast-iron grates set on speckled granite. A gloved hand already holds a steam nozzle that emits a white vapor jet onto the right-side burners. The nozzle sweeps across the right front and rear grate areas and the back edge of the cooktop. As the steam is emitted, the plume expands and drifts leftward over the center, partially veiling the middle burners. The surface appears dark and wet under the continuous contact. The framing gradually widens toward the right, bringing a pale-green steam unit with a black hose into view resting on the counter. The grates remain seated in place throughout the excerpt, and the spraying continues without pause.
